# fleetdm_software_versions (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve information about all FleetDM software versions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all software versions
data "fleetdm_software_versions" "all" {}

output "total_versions_count" {
  value = data.fleetdm_software_versions.all.total_count
}

# Filter by vulnerable software only
data "fleetdm_software_versions" "vulnerable" {
  vulnerable = true
}

output "vulnerable_software" {
  value = [for v in data.fleetdm_software_versions.vulnerable.software_versions : {
    id              = v.id
    version         = v.version
    hosts_count     = v.hosts_count
    vulnerabilities = v.vulnerabilities
  }]
}

# Filter by team
data "fleetdm_software_versions" "team_versions" {
  team_id = fleetdm_team.workstations.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `extension_for` (Set of String) Narrow an extension or plugin source to the browsers or IDEs it is for, e.g. `["brave"]` with `source = ["chrome_extensions"]`. Each value's own source must be listed in `source`; a source without any of its values here matches all of its software. One of: `brave`, `chrome`, `chromium`, `clion`, `cursor`, `datagrip`, `edge`, `edge_beta`, `firefox`, `goland`, `intellij_idea`, `intellij_idea_community_edition`, `opera`, `phpstorm`, `pycharm`, `pycharm_community_edition`, `resharper`, `rider`, `rubymine`, `rust_rov`, `trae`, `vscode`, `vscode_insiders`, `vscodium`, `vscodium_insiders`, `webstorm`, `windsurf`, `yandex`. _Requires Fleet 4.94+._
- `query` (String) Search query to filter software by name.
- `source` (Set of String) Only return software from any of these sources (osquery tables), e.g. `["apps", "chrome_extensions"]`. One of: `adobe_plugins`, `android_apps`, `apps`, `chocolatey_packages`, `chrome_extensions`, `deb_packages`, `firefox_addons`, `go_binaries`, `homebrew_packages`, `ie_extensions`, `ios_apps`, `ipados_apps`, `jetbrains_plugins`, `nix_packages`, `npm_packages`, `pacman_packages`, `pkg_packages`, `portage_packages`, `programs`, `ps1_packages`, `py_packages`, `python_packages`, `rpm_packages`, `safari_extensions`, `sh_packages`, `tgz_packages`, `vscode_extensions`. _Requires Fleet 4.94+._
- `team_id` (Number) Filter by team ID.
- `vulnerable_only` (Boolean) Only return software with known vulnerabilities.

### Read-Only

- `software_versions` (Attributes List) List of software versions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--software_versions))
- `total_count` (Number) Total count of software versions.

<a id="nestedatt--software_versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `software_versions`

Read-Only:

- `hosts_count` (Number) The number of hosts with this version.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the software version.
- `name` (String) The name of the software.
- `source` (String) The source of the software.
- `title_id` (Number) The ID of the parent software title.
- `vendor` (String) The software vendor.
- `version` (String) The version string.
